variation: Upright standing machine calf raise, matching the owner reference screenshot; shoulder pads, hand grips, forefeet on short elevated step and free heels.

equipment: Selectorized standing calf machine with a fixed floor frame and short forefoot step, shoulder carriage that travels vertically on guide rods, grips attached to carriage, visible weight stack.

beats.label: Set your stretch
beats.cue: Stand tall; lower heels below the step.
beats.pose: Bottom stretch, both heels below fixed step.

beats.label: Raise your heels
beats.cue: Push through forefeet; keep knees softly straight.
beats.pose: Heels level with step, body and shoulder carriage slightly raised.

beats.label: Squeeze your calves
beats.cue: Lift heels high and squeeze your calves.
beats.pose: Full controlled tiptoe, heels high, body and shoulder carriage rise together.

beats.label: Hold the top
beats.cue: Pause briefly; keep your torso upright.

beats.label: Lower slowly
beats.cue: Lower your heels slowly without bouncing.

beats.label: Return to stretch
beats.cue: Let heels sink below the step gently.
